attBesluta.text: Works great for measuring the height of my truck and loads.
Great product. Accurate tool to verify height during surveys and rigging over dimensional loads. Nesasary tool for professional survey work with over height products and equipment.
It’s a good product. The only complaint I have is with having to align the button holes as I extend each section. Not a deal breaker, though. For the price, a very good product.

Though invaluable for what it does, these seme a little expensive for what it is imo. But, as a state trooper once told me, "wow, that seems like a lot of money, but It's cheaper than hitting a bridge".
Is a very good product and came as promised. Is made with quality and good materials. It is very easy to use. Delivery was as told and was packed as it should have to protect from damage.
I bought them for the workshop and put my IT tools (precision screwdrivers and tweezers) in them so they’d be within easy reach and have a dedicated spot.
Trotz Lieferung mit Delle gebe ich 5 Sterne. Diese sind dem Support geschuldet, welcher sich umgehend darum gekümmert hat und alles zu meiner Zufriedenheit erledigt hat.

utilisé pour faire un tiroir sous bureau. est arrivé avec un coup dans la façade que je n'ai pas pu détordre. j'ai donc caché l'impact en collage une plaxche de plaquage en chêne. le tiroir est devenu invisible de l'extérieur. par contre facile à monter et les glissières sont agréable à l'usage.

Commande traitée et reçue rapidement en revanche le fond de tiroir était légèrement endommagé alors que le colis semblait intact. Le tiroir répond globalement à mes attente bien que j'aurais aimé plus de hauteur et plus de profondeur. En finale on ne peut pas y stocker grand chose.
Could’ve come with better instructions

This review is of the Vevor 4-in-1 Roller Stand. This is far more rugged than I expected. It is constructed with heavy gauge steel, and everything moves and locks as expected. I expect this will last longer than I will. Vevor hit a home run with this one.

I purchased this roller stand to help with cutting 4 x 8 sheets of plywood. What a difference now and super safe. It has multiple uses which I Love. It is built tough. Easy to put together, about 25 minutes. Made really well and painted very nice. This is not the 1st item I purchased from Vevor and it won't be the last.
Excellent quality, easy to assemble. Works very well for my shop. Stores easily and very compact!
Owned now for 3 weeks. Solid workhorse. I intend on a second soon.

The stands are worth the price, but could have been built a little stronger. Also when flat bar is installed, you can't rotate the head to use v-roller or other head types.
Ein super Qualität und schnelle Lieferung. Kann ich sofort weiter Empfehlen.
Ideal ancor for my lake fishing.very sturdy and designed to keep hold of lake floor... not too heavey
top quality with a decent price. fast shipping. Very pleased with this companies variety of products.
I have been using this drip pan for several weeks now and it has made my kitchen cleanup so much easier.
A little smaller and lighter than expected. But it is still a good buy

For a long time I have been wanting to upgrade some of my pots from aluminum pots to a nice stainless steel. Because this one came with a lid and a steamer basket, it was an easy choice to make. I am very happy with the purchase, and I may come back for more sizes.
Absolutely love this steamer, we blanch a lot of vegetables from the garden before freezing and this is a handy pot for that purpose.
